description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC Controller named StaticContentController that manages static content files in an admin interface. It includes methods for listing, uploading, and deleting static files related to content management.

classes.name: StaticContentController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for managing static content files in the admin interface, including listing, uploading, and deleting static files.

methods.name: getContentImages
methods.description: Handles GET requests to serve the static content files management page.

methods.name: pageStaticContent
methods.description: Handles POST requests to list static content files with their URLs and MIME types.

methods.name: saveFiles
methods.description: Handles POST requests to upload and save new static content files.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a static content file.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets up menu attributes for the model used in views.
